## Service divisions
- [Website development & e-commerce](https://jayant-systems.online/services/websites-ecommerce): We design and develop modern, responsive websites that help businesses establish credibility, attract customers and generate enquiries.
- [Custom software & business systems](https://jayant-systems.online/services/custom-software): We build applications and internal systems around how your business actually operates, helping you replace fragmented tools and manual processes.
- [AI integrations & workflow automation](https://jayant-systems.online/services/ai-automation): We integrate artificial intelligence and automation into everyday business operations, helping teams reduce manual tasks and simplify existing workflows.
- [UI/UX, design & branding](https://jayant-systems.online/services/design-branding): We create consistent, purposeful visual experiences that communicate your brand clearly and make your digital products easier to use.
- [SEO, digital growth & ongoing support](https://jayant-systems.online/services/seo-growth-support): We help businesses maintain, improve and optimise their digital presence through search optimisation, analytics and ongoing technical support.

## Commercial terms
- Every project starts with a defined quotation and agreed deliverables.
- Ownership, source-code access and licences are defined in the project agreement.
- Hosting, subscriptions and third-party costs are disclosed separately.
- No guaranteed revenue, rankings, unlimited revisions, lifetime support or 100% uptime.
- Project-based development: From ₹40,000
- Monthly digital partnership: From ₹2,999 / month
- Startup & MVP partnership: Quoted after a scoping call
- Technology consulting: Quoted after a scoping call
- End-to-end digital partnership: Quoted after a scoping call

## How we work
01. Discover — Understand your business, customers, current systems, challenges and goals.
02. Define — Agree on the requirements, deliverables, budget, timeline and responsibilities.
03. Design — Plan the experience, technical architecture and visual direction.
04. Build — Develop the agreed solution and share progress throughout the project.
05. Verify — Test functionality, usability, responsiveness and agreed acceptance criteria.
06. Launch — Deploy the solution, provide documentation and complete the handover.
07. Support & improve — Maintain and improve the solution through an agreed support arrangement.

## Commitments
- Transparent pricing: Know what you're paying for before development begins.
- Defined scope: Every project starts with clearly agreed deliverables.
- Direct communication: Work directly with the people responsible for your project.
- Regular progress updates: Stay informed throughout the development process.
- Quality checks: Agreed deliverables are tested before handover.
- Client ownership: Ownership and access rights are clearly defined before work begins.
- Documented handover: Receive the agreed files, credentials and documentation.
- Practical solutions: We recommend what your business needs, not unnecessary features.
- Confidentiality: Your business information is handled according to agreed confidentiality terms.
- Ongoing support: Continued assistance is available under agreed support plans.
- Cost transparency: Hosting, subscriptions and third-party expenses are disclosed separately.
- Founder-led execution: Direct founder involvement and accountability.

## FAQ
### Do you only build websites?
No. Jayant Systems works across website development, custom software, AI automation, design and branding, digital optimisation and technical support.

### Can you improve my existing website instead of building a new one?
Yes. We can review your existing website and recommend targeted improvements or a complete redesign, depending on your requirements.

### Can you automate my existing business processes?
Yes. We assess your current workflows and identify suitable opportunities for automation and software integration.

### Do you work with small businesses?
Yes. Our services can be scoped around the needs and budgets of small businesses, startups, institutions and larger organisations.

### How much does a project cost?
Pricing depends on project complexity, requirements, integrations and timelines. We provide a defined quotation after understanding your requirements.

### How long does a project take?
The timeline is determined by the project's scope and complexity. An agreed delivery schedule is established before work begins.

### Will I own my website or software?
Ownership, source-code access, licences and third-party dependencies are defined in the project agreement before work begins.

### Do you provide support after launch?
Yes. Ongoing maintenance and support can be arranged according to your requirements and the agreed service plan.

### Can you manage multiple aspects of my digital presence?
Yes. Our engagement models can combine development, automation, design and ongoing support through a single coordinated partnership.

### How do payments work?
Payments are milestone-based and set out in the project agreement. We accept bank transfer, UPI and other agreed methods.

### Do you sign NDAs?
Yes. We're happy to sign a non-disclosure agreement before you share project details.

### Can you handle hosting and deployment?
Yes. We deploy to platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, AWS or Google Cloud, and help with domains, SSL and email setup. Hosting costs are billed separately and disclosed upfront.

### Will my website work on phones?
Yes. Every website and application is designed and tested for mobile, tablet and desktop before handover.

### Which technologies do you use?
Mostly Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python and FastAPI, with PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Supabase, and AI models from providers such as OpenAI, Google and Anthropic. We choose what suits the project rather than forcing one stack.

### How do you handle security?
We follow standard practice: HTTPS, secure authentication, role-based access, input validation and regular dependency updates. Any ongoing security work is agreed in a support plan.

### How do we get started?
Book a 15-minute call or send a project brief. We'll understand your goals, recommend an approach and send a written proposal with scope, timeline and cost before any work begins.
